register_scenario_class: use the register_scenario decorator to register a new Scenario subclass with a unique scenario ID
get_scenario_by_id: call registry.get_scenario with a scenario ID string to retrieve the registered Scenario class
discover_all_scenarios: call registry.get_all_scenarios to discover entry points and return all registered scenario classes as a dictionary
reset_scenario_registry: call registry.reset to clear all registered scenarios and reset discovery state for testing
discover_scenarios_via_entry_points: call _discover_and_import_scenarios to load builtin scenarios and discover additional scenarios from installed package entry points
